text: Every character is a class function: $\chi_V(hgh^{-1})=\chi_V(g)$ for all $g,h\in G$.
explanation: True: because trace is invariant under conjugation, $\chi_V(hgh^{-1})=\mathrm{tr}(\rho(h)\rho(g)\rho(h)^{-1})=\mathrm{tr}(\rho(g))=\chi_V(g)$. Hence every character is constant on conjugacy classes, i.e. a class function.
